Name: Hermit Isle Farm
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
Adds the hermit isle farm, a new crossroad location and a custom farmcave.
Enjoy Stardew Valley with a fresh breeze!
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15132/15132-1709348503-2078098314.png[/img]

[size=3][b]Features of the farm[/b][/size]:
[list]
[*]Foraging spawning in green areas
[*]Snails visit occasionally
[*]Coconut garden
[*]Crates and Critters occassionally wash upon the coast
[*]Catch Beach fish at the coast and Mountain fish at the inner pond
[*]Mystery fishing area; reward pool increases as you play. What could be inside?
[*]Decorative lying area with working furniture
[*]Direct access to a minecart next to the farmhouse
[*] Plenty of tillable sand
[/list]
[size=3][b]New Crossroad location!
[/b][/size]Spice up your playthrough with a new crossroad location where the farm once was!
NPCs will use it for their daily needs and pass you by more naturally and commonly.
Use it as an additional foraging and forestry area.

[b][size=3]New Custom Farmcave!
[/size][/b]The farmcave is a bit bigger now and you can even place casks there now!
Use that additional space for your processing needs.
But where could it be?

[size=3][b]Supported Mods:[/b][/size]
Special care went into making sure these mods look visually pleasing.
[list]
[*]Stardewvalley Expanded
[*]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor
[*]NPCMapLocations
[/list]
This mod is multingual and does not replace any vanilla farms.
